notes_for_editor: Only source is the tnlandforms.us list. Name and county match the record. The GFC number field, the last on the line, is blank for this entry, so the list gives no register code (the record has none either). Two WebSearch queries (Putnam County, Rockville, GFC fire tower) found no history. NHLR has no page for it (404 on nhlr.org/lookouts/us/ga/rockville-lookout-tower/). A cached TopoZone page for Jefferson Lookout Tower (data/raw/web/80a4c1fcfea6 family of files) lists a 'Rockville Lookout Tower' among nearby USGS features with map area 'Rockville'; it gives no coordinates or history and is not cited. A Putnam Examiner search hit describing a 1940 CCC fire tower is about Putnam County, New York, and was not used. Elevation unit (feet) is inferred as for Rockridge; the page prints none. Status and access unknown, so no keys are set. Low confidence; deliberately short.
